item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President establishes and assigns duties to a White House personnel-management official, requires Commission consultation, and preserves existing administrative actions pending later change. These are immediate internal organizational and management directions; any compensation rate or later substantive action remains to be set by authorized officials.","evidence":"There shall be in the White House Office an official who shall be appointed by the President"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Special Assistant is directed to perform assigned functions using available White House and, when appropriate, agency personnel; the remaining language defines internal terms. This governs staffing and internal administration without itself changing legal rights.","evidence":"shall perform his functions under this order with the assistance of such personnel of the White House Office as may be provided for that purpose"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately revokes an earlier executive order concerning the internal assignment of federal personnel-management functions. Under the codebook, such an administrative reorganization is Code 1 despite taking immediate effect.","evidence":"Executive Order No. 10452 of May 1, 1953, entitled \"Providing for the Performance by the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission of Certain Functions Relating to Personnel Management\", is hereby revoked."}]}
